title: Water & Wastewater Company product catalogue, version 1
sourceDescription: Selected product evidence from current vendor pages, checked on 21 November 2026. Claims state what the vendor describes, not proven suitability for an organisation. Editorial review is pending. Coverage spans the sector’s main capability areas but is not exhaustive; a missing product is not evidence that no product exists.

entries.summary: A digital water platform for operational analysis.

capabilities.name: Leakage Detection & Control
capabilities.howItSupports: Uses network information to identify potential leakage

capabilities.name: Water Quality Monitoring & Compliance
capabilities.howItSupports: Provides water quality information for operations

claims.statement: The vendor describes Xylem Vue as a digital water platform for operational analysis.

entries.summary: Hydraulic modelling software for water distribution systems.

capabilities.name: Network Modelling & Hydraulics
capabilities.howItSupports: Models and analyses water distribution hydraulics

claims.statement: The vendor describes OpenFlows Water as hydraulic modelling software for water distribution systems.

entries.summary: Integrated catchment modelling software for drainage networks.

capabilities.name: Sewer Network Operations
capabilities.howItSupports: Models sewer and drainage network behaviour

claims.statement: The vendor describes InfoWorks ICM as integrated catchment modelling software for drainage networks.

entries.summary: Process control software used in water operations.

capabilities.name: Water Treatment Operations
capabilities.howItSupports: Monitors and controls water treatment processes

claims.statement: The vendor describes SIMATIC PCS neo as process control software used in water operations.

entries.summary: Network information management and analysis software for utilities.

capabilities.name: Network Modelling & Hydraulics

claims.statement: The vendor describes ArcGIS Utility Network as network information management and analysis software for utilities.

entries.summary: Customer information and service software for utilities.

capabilities.name: Customer Contact & Self-Service

claims.statement: The vendor describes IFS Copperleaf as asset investment planning software for utilities.
